title: Day Dream
description:
DNS and Local Governance present Day Dream: a rooftop Saturday you do not want to miss, filled with the rhythms and sounds of Summer. Come enjoy the sun with your friends, and live in a Day Dream you'll always remember.

A 6 hour vibe: 2:00 pm - 8:00 pm October 3rd see you soon and get ready to dance all afternoon!

Headliner **MXXDY** with Support by **Macmillan, Austin Freeman, MKM and Knives.**
